visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up hands using a specialized tool to pry open a Golden Churn butter tin on a white marble surface. Milk powder and sugar are added from a yellow packet. The camera is positioned at a high angle to focus on the bowl's contents. (3) Hands use a white spatula to scrape and fold a smooth, thick yellow butter mixture in a clear bowl. The background shows a clean, modern kitchen environment with various appliances and a white counter. (4) The main character, a woman with dark hair in a pink sweater, appears at eye-level. She covers several small balls of dough on a marble slab with plastic wrap. Blinds and a kitchen window are visible behind her. (5) Close-up shot of the woman's hands flattening a yellow topping onto a ball of white dough. A digital scale and a tray of already prepared pineapple bun dough are seen in the blurred background. (6) The scene cuts to long, oval-shaped pieces of dough being rolled out with a marble rolling pin. The movement is smooth and deliberate. The lighting remains bright, emphasizing the soft texture of the dough. (7) A tray of raw pineapple buns and oval dough sticks are brushed with yellow egg wash. The camera uses a medium close-up shot size. The woman uses a silicone brush to apply the liquid evenly. (8) The woman, wearing a white and grey patterned oven mitt, slides the baking tray into a modern black and white oven. The interior of the oven is lit, showing other trays of rising bread inside. (9) Close-up of the finished pineapple buns being removed from the oven. They have a characteristic cracked, golden-brown crust. The woman uses a metal spatula to move them onto a wire cooling rack. (10) A long, golden-brown bun is sliced open on a wooden cutting board. Hands spread a generous layer of yellow cream inside and then dip the sliced surface into a tray of fine peanut powder.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Opens with the metallic scraping and prying sound of a butter tin lid being removed. A bright, mid-tempo acoustic pop background music starts with guitar strumming. A female voice begins narrating with a friendly, professional tone and moderate pacing. (2) Transitions as the whirring mechanical sound of a food processor kicks in, blending butter and dry ingredients. The narrator explains the breakfast plan for her kids. The BGM maintains a steady, cheerful beat with light percussion. (3) Features the wet, sticky sound of a spatula mixing yellow butter paste against a bowl. The narrator's voice has a warm, motherly quality with slight rising intonations. The background music remains upbeat and consistent in the background. (4) Marked by the soft thumping and rustling of dough being kneaded and weighed on a digital scale. The narrator discusses the "classic" flavors of the bread. Acoustic guitar continues as the primary melodic element in the BGM. (5) Introduces the high-frequency buzzing of an electric hand mixer used in a stainless bowl. The narrator mentions the importance of Golden Churn butter. The music's major-key tonality complements the bright, domestic atmosphere of the scene. (6) Triggered by the sharp rustle of plastic wrap being stretched over dough balls. The narrator reflects on her daughter returning home for winter break. The vocal delivery becomes more sentimental and soft-spoken during this sequence. (7) Acoustic shift occurs with the metallic click of an oven door opening and the subsequent sliding of a tray. The narrator expresses gratitude to her audience. The music swells slightly with increased harmonic tension towards the end. (8) Concludes with the crisp, percussive slicing sound of a knife through a baked bun and the rustle of peanut powder. The narrator asks a closing question to the viewers. The BGM fades out with a final melodic flourish.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate a traditional bread-making recipe while sharing a personal, emotional narrative about the creator's family. The video combines practical cooking steps with a heartfelt message of gratitude to the audience.
